title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1492: Spear of qin (3)

section.p: Qin Zhen’s past body was coughing blood repeatedly. In fact, this body was on the verge of falling apart. Immortal King Yueshi was starting to gain more and more advantage over him.

Zhou Tianfang was starting to grow anxious. Even Xia Longwu and Zhou Polong were attacking madly, desperate to defeat their opponents. They were able to inflict numerous wounds on their opponents in their madness, but those wounds were not heavy enough to do much harm to their opponents.
The immortals were clearly trying to drag this out. They only needed to drag this out long enough for Qin Zhen to die. His death would signify their victory.

It was rather unlikely that the other races would attack them in the event of their victory. Nothing could stay victorious forever. They could kill the humans without much repercussions, but the same couldn’t be said for the immortals. They had to consider the overall strength of the immortal race before doing so. Could they survive the wrath of the immortal race upon leaving the mansion?
Meanwhile, the divines and devils were still saying provocative words in their attempt to lure him out. He merely ignored them.
Suddenly, a series of giggles rang out in the air.
Instantly, the divines and devils attacked.

Space collapsed as numerous Lan Tians crumbled apart. Far away, a scholarly Lan Tian in white robes said softly, “I don’t think…I have the ability to help. Humans…are truly complicated. I have long known the result, yet I’m still here.”
Step by step, he walked forward. He smiled gently, but suddenly, his smile turned into a smile of sadness and madness, “I want my revenge!”
The space trembled.
“I have been wronged!”
Once again, he resonated with Old Zhou. That was the only way for him to gain more strength here. Yes. Lan Tian had shown himself. He could not hold back.
While coughing blood, Qin Zhen laughed and said, “Lan Tian, what is a madman like you doing here?”

Surrounded by Invincibles, Lan Tian spoke with a pitiful voice, “I don’t want to, but…I have no choice. My myriad clones told me to keep hiding. But…my human clone is dumb. He told me to go. He told me not to be scared.”

While laughing like a lunatic, Lan Tian said, “I am a human. I have never betrayed humanity. Isn’t that so? I only wish to forge my own version of humanity. My dream humanity. But I am still a human. Isn’t that so?”
“Why must you call me a traitor? I’m not. Tiansheng isn’t. We are humans. We are humans. Are we humans, Qin Zhen?”

After coughing a mouthful of blood, Qin Zhen said, “Yes. You’re humans. But we were scared that the myriad races would target us if we acknowledged that. But now, I understand. I fucking understand. It does not matter. Only strength matters. If you’re weak, you bend over. That is all.”
A loud bang rang out.
Finally, one Qin Zhen was defeated. A carrier treasure dropped from the sky.
“Qin Zhen!”
Xia Longwu roared furiously.
The remaining Qin Zhens sighed helplessly and said, “You can’t blame me. I fucking tried my best. I..I’m not his match. I’m sorry. Sorry. Sorry…”
Suddenly, he stared at Immortal King Yueshi and grinned.

Immortal King Yueshi asked coldly, “Are you thinking of detonating yourself? That won’t hurt me. If you do that, you will spawn a death sovereigns. The observers will move you out of the residence before killing you. You won’t have the chance to complete your self-detonation. Stop being stupid. This is pointless.”
When Qin Zhen looked around, one Invincible after another stepped out of the void indifferently. Yes. They were using their presence to prove that Immortal King Yueshi was right.
“This feels terrible.” Qin Zhen laughed and said, “Truly terrible. Do I not have the ability to even choose how I die?”
After losing one of his three bodies, he had weakened significantly. He could no longer be their match.
This was his limit.
Inside the Illusory Heaven Mirror.
Su Yu’s body shook slightly as he kept telling himself to ignore them all.

Qin Zhen’s life did not concern him. He didn’t even know Qin Zhen well. He had only met Qin Zhen a few times. He first met Qin Zhen during their time at Great Ming. Back then, Qin Zhen was a straightforward and carefree man. With a smile, Qin Zhen had told him how great it was to kill immortal fairies. Qin Zhen had also told him that immortal fairies were best killed in secret.
He invited Su Yu to Great Qin, promising him the greatest bloodbath of his life after joining them.
He told Su Yu that Great Qin was the best prefecture under the heaven.
He told Su Yu that Great Qin was strong enough to sweep through the Myriad Realms.
They weren’t close.
He told Su Yu that Great Qin did not have any corpses in stock. They needed to go on a hunt to collect the required corpses. A few days later, Su Yu received some fresh corpses.
This was one of the few humans Su Yu was unfamiliar with yet didn’t hate. In fact, Su Yu found him interesting and fun.
Qin Zhen.

Prefect of Great Qin, one who had spent hundreds of years in the Allheaven Battlefield, one who had swept through the Myriad Realms at the helm of the armies of Great Qin. He was the guardian of the human border. He was someone who had killed numerous enemies of humanity.
Today, he lost one of his three bodies. Right in front of Su Yu’s eyes.
“The strong are free to share their benevolence while the weak shall always prioritize themselves.”
These were the words Wan Tiansheng had told him. He was taught not to get involved in matters beyond his ability to handle.
Did he have the ability to handle this?

Su Yu did not know the answer. He only knew that many of his trump cards had only been prepared for the nine-leaf skylotus, not to help Qin Zhen. Why should he care about Qin Zhen? He needed the nine-leaf skylotus.
With the skylotus, he would grow strong. Upon growing strong, he would have the ability to do whatever he wanted.
Why must he expose his trump cards for Qin Zhen, someone he didn’t even know that well?
Suddenly, Su Yu rippled his death qi, “Lord, please enter the residence. Throw everything into chaos.”
Outside the Devote King’s residence, Xing Yue raised her brow.
The nine-leaf skylotus had yet to bloom.

She could potentially snatch one of the petals if she were to enter when it was blooming. But…Su Yu was telling her to enter now. Was he giving up on the nine-leaf skylotus? This would expose more than he wanted.
But soon, Xing Yue decided it was too tiring to think so much. Thus, she sneered and rushed into the Devote King’s residence. At the same time, Dummy and two other death sovereigns did the same.
Four death sovereigns had entered at the same time.
The Invincibles inside the residence were alarmed. Why were these death spirits here when the immortals were on the verge of victory against the humans?
Inside the residence, Xing Yue roared, “Kill the immortals! How dare they challenge me?”
Xing Yue sent a palm attack toward Immortal King Yueshi, interrupting the immortal king’s attempt to kill Qin Zhen. He roared furiously, “The humans are colluding with the death spirits!”
He was certain.
He roared, “Are you seeing this, everyone? The humans are colluding with the death spirits!”
This was too big of a coincidence. It was way too convenient. Why were they attacking just as he was about to kill Qin Zhen? Was this truly a coincidence? What nonsense.
In fact, the other Invincibles had also reached the same conclusion.

At the same time, Xing Yue’s voice rang out in the mind of the celestial chasm Invincible, “We will be pretending to help the humans against the immortals. After killing the immortals, we will kill the humans. We will turn all humans into death spirits. Find a way to delay the other races.”
Just as the celestial chasm Invincible hesitated, Xing Yue’s voice arrived again, “Don’t forget the oath.”
At that reminder, the celestial chasm Invincible’s expression changed as he roared, “The skylotus will bloom soon! Let’s join hands to move them all away from this place!”

Noticing the gazes of the various Invincibles on him, he continued, “It doesn’t matter if they are colluding with each other. We can’t allow the death spirits to damage the skylotus. Unlike us, the death spirits do not care about it!”
That instantly triggered a reaction from the various Invincibles. More than ten of them acted together. In the blink of an eye, the eight Invincibles in combat were moved far away from the skylotus.
Qin Zhen, who was waiting for the final battle, blanked out slightly before rushing toward Xing Yue out of nowhere.

Whatever. Since the death spirits were targeting the immortals as well, he might as well join hands with the death spirits for now. Sure, it was far more likely for him to die in the hands of the death spirits first, but he didn’t care anymore.
If he was going to die either way, he would rather die to the death spirits.
Inside the Illusory Heaven Mirror.
Su Yu exhaled lightly.
This had exposed one of his trump cards. This was enough to cause some Invincibles to hesitate before doing anything. His biggest trump card had been exposed.
Did he regret it?

Slightly. He had been cursing Qin Zhen nonstop inwardly for being useless. Alas, he had to help Qin Zhen as gratitude for Qin Zhen’s guidance in how to kill immortal fairies. Yes. He still remembered Qin Zhen telling him that immortal fairies were the most beautiful when they were dead.
This was his way of repaying that debt. He would not save Qin Zhen anymore after this.
At the same time.
The expressions of some people turned odd.

Blood Fire Devil King said, “Were these death spirits here because of the human race…or Su Yu? As a pseudo death spirit, Su Yu is probably capable of communicating with the death spirits. Is this him?”
Blood Fire Devil King sighed, “What an incredible freak. Holy city guardians, ancient race of soul devourers, and death sovereigns. Is Su Yu capable of colluding with anyone he wants?”

He smiled and continued, “See, I’m right. As living beings, nobody can stop caring about their own race. Even Su Yu, even Lan Tian, even Wan Tiansheng…can’t stop caring. They might be disappointed in humanity. They might hate humanity. But they can’t stop caring. Their claims that they are no longer humans is nothing but a joke.”
Umbra had mixed feelings about this. Was he gratified? Was he sad? Was he helpless?
He was feeling all those emotions at the same time.
A human would always be a human.
When it mattered, all these lunatics had stepped forth. Such was Lan Tian. Such was Su Yu. Umbra knew very well that this death spirit was most likely the one who had reached an agreement with Su Yu.
Su Yu. What an incredible individual.
How did he do this?
Alas, the more potential he showed, the more others would want to kill him. With a sigh, Umbra stepped forth. Instantly, Blood Fire Devil King appeared before him and said, “Are you really going?”
“Well, you were right. As fellow humans, it would be pointless to claim that we don’t care. It would be a total joke. And I am a human.”
Umbra smiled and said, “Blood Fire, looks like you’re really determined to fight me today.”
Blood Fire Devil King remained silent for a long while before replying, “No. You are the one determined to fight me. Are you confident, Great Ming King?”
“Great Ming King?”

Umbra laughed, “Old Zhu…isn’t here. He wouldn’t have stayed silent while Qin Zhen was in trouble. Alas, I am the cold-blooded one. Even when my son is dying, I refused to act. All for the sake of the greater good…”
“What?”
A deafening hum explosion erupted as Blood Fire Devil King was sent flying while coughing blood.

With his back straight, Umbra said, “That foolish son of mine has always been stupid. I thought of sacrificing my own son since everyone was willing to sacrifice themselves for me. Does that make me a great man? Or does that make me cold-blooded? Am I unfeeling? I can’t die here. I can only show up at the final moment to win the skylotus. Otherwise, things will get very troublesome. Unfortunately…sigh. I don’t think I’m qualified to become the Pseudo Emperor of humanity. I am selfish. I am still afraid of losing my son. I can only apologize to Old Zhou and the others for my impatience.”
A spear appeared in the sky.
Everyone was stunned.
The guardian of humanity. Great Qin King. He…was here.
The divines, devils, and other races instantly went crazy.
Lightning Divine King roared, “Kill! Kill him! Humanity will mourn this loss!”
“Kill!”
The various Invincibles roared madly.
Great Qin King! It was Great Qin King!
Humanity would be finished with Great Qin King’s death. They would lose someone capable of uniting them in a loose alliance.

Great Qin King was not supposed to expose himself. He was right. Exposing himself prematurely would turn him into everyone’s target. It would be fine for Great Ming King to be here instead. After all, he was not the guardian of humanity. But Great Qin King was different.
“Father!”
Qin Zhen was stunned. Why was his father here? Wasn’t that supposed to be Zhu Tianfang’s father?

Great Qin King smiled at his son, but soon, his smile turned stiff as he scolded, “Are you stupid? Why? Why do I have such a stupid son? This is so embarrassing. I was prepared to let you die! But…but…an outsider told me that even those unwilling to consider themselves humans are helping you. As a father…can I be so cold-blooded?”
The expressions of the other human Invincibles changed drastically. Zhu Tianfang roared, “You! If you were to die here, what would happen to humanity?”
More than ten Invincibles charged toward Great Qin King unhesitatingly.
Su Yu was a future threat. But Great Qin King was a current threat. Killing Great Qin King would destroy humanity’s present. Without the present, there would be no future.
This was the most valuable human in existence.
“If humanity falls just because of this, so be it. Perhaps they deserve such a fate…”
Great Qin King smiled and said, “There will always be someone new. Someone to prop the sky above us up again. Brothers, I will be troubling you all after my departure.”

With a rumble, his spear stabbed through space itself before sending Blood Fire Devil King flying. Then, it flickered and appeared before Immortal King Yueshi. Immortal King Yueshi’s expression changed drastically, but he couldn’t even react before his heart was pierced through by the spear. Next, his River of Time snapped.
Then, the final Immortal King Yueshi was stabbed through.
An explosion erupted.
Crimson clouds appeared in the sky.
Dead.
Yes. He was dead.
Yes. Great Qin King had killed Immortal King Yueshi with only three moves.
By the time Immortal King Yueshi was dead, Great Qin King had been surrounded by more than ten Invincibles.
With a cold smile on his face, Great Qin King said, “Let the first kill be the tribute to my banner. It has been a while since I last killed a bastard. So…how many of you are prepared to die today?”
How many of them were prepared to die today? Fear rippled through the other Invincibles.
Spear of Qin. Great Qin King.
How many of them would die killing him?
